content.short: Portal is Wormhole's official bridge app for moving tokens and NFTs between Ethereum, Solana, Sui and 30+ other chains.
content.description: Portal is the consumer front end for Wormhole token transfers. You pick a source and destination chain, and Portal handles the lock-and-mint or burn-and-mint flow behind the scenes, with each transfer verified by Wormhole's Guardian network. It supports USDC, ETH, SOL and over a hundred other tokens across EVM chains, Solana, Sui and Aptos. That saves stitching several bridges together. Transfers have no per-transfer caps, and NFTs can be bridged as well as tokens.
